llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose (sending Feishu messages using the agent's app credentials); it reads local agent config and logs and calls Feishu's official API endpoints only.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name/description (send Feishu messages as the current Agent) aligns with the provided script and documentation. Reading the agent's Feishu appId/appSecret from ~/.openclaw/openclaw-{agent}.json and calling open.feishu.cn are expected for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent/user to read the agent's configuration files and to grep journalctl for open_id — these actions are sensitive (access to app secrets and logs) but are explained and necessary for the stated goal. The SKILL.md and send.sh only post to Feishu's official API and do not send data to other external endpoints. One operational note: the script interpolates the message directly into an escaped JSON string which may break or mis-encode complex input (quotes, newlines).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with an included shell script; there is no network download/install step. The project lists dependencies (curl, jq) which are reasonable and expected.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or remote credentials are requested by the registry metadata. The script reads local config files (~/.openclaw/openclaw-*.json) to obtain App ID and App Secret — this is necessary for API access but gives the skill access to sensitive credentials and local agent logs. That access is proportionate to the skill's function but should be considered sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills or system settings, and has no install step that writes services. Default autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other high-risk factors here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it reads the agent's local Feishu app credentials (~/.openclaw/openclaw-*.json) and journalctl logs to obtain open_id, then calls Feishu's official API to send messages. Before installing, verify you trust the skill source and that those config files contain only credentials you expect to be used. Ensure curl and jq are installed, check file permissions on ~/.openclaw so the skill can't read unrelated secrets, and confirm the agent user has only the necessary journalctl access. If you need stronger safeguards, run the script in a restricted environment or rotate the app secret after testing. Note: the script interpolates message text directly into JSON and may mis-handle quotes/newlines — validate or sanitize message content if needed.
